displayProperties.subtitle: T. Reformation Quartermaster
displayProperties.description: Curious Vex unit serving as Tharsis Reformation quartermaster.
displayProperties.name: Reformancer Guzheng

interactions.flavorLineOne:
Reformancer Guzheng synthesizes a droning chord under its voice as it speaks.

"The renegade Guardian has performed to expectations set by Zephyrus, Autonomous Mind," it says. "The Reformancer unit has in turn allocated a portion of our most recent shipment to the Guardian."

"As part of an ongoing social experiment, the Guzheng unit has left your goods with Spider. This unit is measuring how long he can resist the temptation to pocket the funds himself."

Guzheng's eye gleams with a threatening light. "At that point, the experiment will conclude."

The Reformancer greets you with a dramatic flourish of its garments. "This unit, designated Guzheng, currently serves as Reformancer. This title is unique and a pleasing degree of outré, just like Guzheng itself.

"You are extremely puncturable, Guardian unit. Flammable too, in our experience. Might I suggest this defensive tool? Our organization is willing to part with it as a token of equivalent exchange."

Guzheng focuses on your Exotic armor for a moment too long as you take the Deflector unit. Then its gaze snaps back to yours. "May this improve your odds."

Reformancer Guzheng unfolds itself from a crouch on your approach. 

"Zephyrus requests your assistance in trouncing our pathetic foes. Rewards are promised, as are access to desirable items and abilities.

"Have you ever thought about what it would be like to be part of the Vex? Your imagination could not simulate reality, but our Deflectors and Stun Fields may give you a taste.

"Gamble on the Reformation. Win big."
Deposit Dark Matter Ingots at the Tharsis Reformation War Chest to earn Reputation with this syndicate. Earn gear, Renegade Abilities, Praxic Blade modifications, and currency.
